engine.name: oniguruma
engine.rule: The worker passes the inlined Oniguruma WASM to createOnigurumaEngine.

catalog.rule: The product selects grammars from Shiki’s bundled language catalog by id or catalog alias.

registrations.name: angular-html
inlineInjectionSelectors: R:text.html - (comment.block, text.html meta.embedded, meta.tag.*.*.html, meta.tag.*.*.*.html, meta.tag.*.*.*.*.html)

registrations.name: blade
inlineInjectionSelectors: text.html.php.blade - (meta.embedded | meta.tag | comment.block.blade), L:(text.html.php.blade meta.tag - (comment.block.blade | meta.embedded.block.blade)), L:(source.js.embedded.html - (comment.block.blade | meta.embedded.block.blade))

registrations.name: edge
inlineInjectionSelectors: text.html.edge - (meta.embedded | meta.tag | comment.block.edge), L:(text.html.edge meta.tag - (comment.block.edge | meta.embedded.block.edge)), L:(source.ts.embedded.html - (comment.block.edge | meta.embedded.block.edge))

labelResolution.rule: A label is trimmed and lowercased, then looked up in the editor overrides, then in the catalog ids and aliases; no match is plain text.

documentLanguageMap.rule: Documents map every catalog id and alias plus the overrides, minus the ids left to extension inference.

documentResolution.rule: A document uses the configured map entry, then .tsx/.jsx extension inference, then the plugin default map.

preload.rule: Without a host census these grammars load in the background after the first highlight.

registrationLoading.rule: A grammar's registrations are its module's default export: dependencies first, then its own grammar; the worker keeps the first of each (name, scopeName).

sentinels.rule: A snippet label with no grammar is highlighted with no language and reports this language name.
The worker returns only the theme when the snippet has no language or no text.
A document whose language resolves to no grammar gets no highlighter session.
Without a worker, documents get no highlighter session.

loadErrors.rule: A known grammar that fails to load rejects the highlight with code 'failed', and the failed load is not cached.
Loading a label with no grammar throws.
A worker error rejects with code 'failed'; an environment without workers rejects with 'unavailable'.
A resolver answer with no registrations, or one without name and scopeName, throws; a failed answer is evicted from the cache.

policies.rule: Imported VS Code themes color documents through the Shiki highlighter; native palettes color through Tree-sitter captures.
The host loads a selected theme as the default export of its bundled ESM module; there is no JSONC parsing or include resolution.
Before the worker sees a registration, the service copies settings and tokenColors arrays and drops undefined workbench colors.
A theme is loaded under a name that changes whenever its content does.
A native palette converts to a TextMate theme with a source-scope foreground rule and one rule per mapped syntax color.

grammarCall.rule: Each non-empty line within the limit is tokenized with the rule stack the previous line ended in; a time limit of 0 disables the time check.

lineLimit.rule: A line longer than the limit becomes one token with an empty scope path, painted with the theme defaults, and passes the incoming grammar state on unchanged.

referenceCases.rule: A line over the limit inside an unterminated construct leaves the next line in that construct, because the incoming state passes through.

lines.rule: Text splits on LF; a CR ending a line is removed from that line, and every separator counts as one UTF-16 unit in offsets.
An empty line yields no tokens and passes the incoming grammar state on unchanged.
An edit retokenizes from the state before its first line until the end state matches the old one; a batch applies highest offset first.
The tokenizer counts lines left plain by the limit, and every worker answer carries that count.

installedShikiDefaults.rule: Defaults of the installed Shiki token and HAST APIs. The product tokenizes through grammar.tokenizeLine directly, so none of them applies to it.

highlighter.rule: The worker builds its highlighter with only these options and tokenizes through the product wrapper, not the Shiki token API.

scopes.rule: Tokens with the same ordered scope list share one style entry keyed by the whole list.
Theme rules are matched from the outermost scope inward; a match overrides the foreground unless it is 0 and the font style unless it is -1.
A theme change recolors the retained scope entries without tokenizing again.
Tokens starting at or past the line end are dropped; every other raw token becomes one token, with no coalescing.
A token exposes content, offset, color and fontStyle; its scopes stay private to the tokenizer.

editorTokens.rule: Tokens become editor tokens at document offsets; empty tokens and tokens with no style are dropped, and equal styles share one palette entry.

registry.rule: Loading a grammar whose name is already loaded does nothing.
Balanced bracket selectors default to every scope.
Loading a grammar reloads every loaded grammar that lists it in embeddedLangsLazy.
Injections registered with injectTo apply to every dotted prefix of the target scope.
A grammar's own aliases are registered with it.
Shiki moves tokenColors to settings when settings is absent, defaults the type to dark, and replaces non-hex colors with generated placeholders.
